title: Eswap CoW Protocol appData — leveraged fill commitment
description: Validated schema for the CoW Protocol `appData` field that authorises a leveraged Eswap fill. The order's appData MUST carry `leverageCommitment(leverage)` = keccak256(abi.encodePacked('eswap-cow-leverage-v1', uint8(leverage))) or the settlement reverts LeverageCommitmentMismatch. This is the trader-signed underwriting signal: the trader authorises the exact leverage the solver may apply.

name.description: Display name shown in the CoW orderbook UI.

version.description: Semver of the appData format itself.

appCode.description: MUST equal the on-chain APP_DATA_LEVERAGE_TAG (EswapCoWSettlement.sol:87). The settlement hashes this tag together with the leverage byte, so a different appCode produces a commitment the settlement will not recognise.

docRef.description: Documentation URL published to IPFS alongside this metadata.

logoUrl.description: Optional logo for the orderbook UI.

leverageCommitment.description: bytes32 = keccak256(abi.encodePacked('eswap-cow-leverage-v1', uint8(leverage))). Reproduce with EswapCoWSettlement.leverageCommitment(uint8 leverage). This is the ONLY field the settlement reads out of appData.

leverage.description: Human-readable mirror of the commitment, for UI display only. The contract reads `leverageCommitment`, NOT this field. Keep the two consistent; a mismatch is not detectable on-chain and will confuse dispute resolution.

settlementAddress.description: EswapCoWSettlement on Unichain. Not yet deployed — the live address is still the zero address in integrations/solvers/shared.ts. Do not publish an order against an undeployed settler.

market.description: Pool identity the fill targets. registerPool is owner-only, so an order may only reference registered pairs.

feeTier.description: Only fee tier 3000 is registered on the live adapter.

solverRequirements.description: What a solver must bond to fill. Derived from borrowAmount = margin * (leverage - 1).

marginAmount.description: Trader margin in tokenIn base units (USDC = 6 decimals). NOT notional.

escrowBondRequired.description: True when the filling solver is not governance-whitelisted and must post erc20BorrowEscrow >= borrowedAmount first.

riskDisclosure.description: Fields surfaced in the orderbook UI so the trader consents knowingly. Keep in sync with the deployed contracts.

roundTripCostBps.description: 10 bps protocol toll each way + 5 bps settlement pool fee each way + 0 bps flash premium.

minMarginWarning.description: CollateralTooLow() (0xb67e07e5) was observed at a 0.01 USDC margin on the live deployment. Read the live minimum rather than assuming dust margins fill.

solverPaymentPriority.const: principal + accumulatedYield, paid before the liquidator incentive (EswapMarginHookLogic2.sol:496-500)
solverPaymentPriority.description: Solver is senior to the trader and to the liquidator incentive. This is a PRIORITY claim, NOT a guarantee — uncovered shortfall after insurance is booked as badDebt (line 492) and the solver payout is truncated to proceeds (line 497).

keeperStatus.const: EswapLiquidationKeeper is unit-tested but NOT deployed on Unichain; no automated liquidation is currently active on the live deployment.
keeperStatus.description: Must be shown to the trader. Do not imply automated protection that does not exist.

positionOwnership.const: The fill credits the position DIRECTLY to the order recipient. The order's receiver must resolve back to the order owner, otherwise ReceiverMismatch.

riskDisclosure.minMarginWarning: A 0.01 USDC margin reverted CollateralTooLow() on the live deployment; read the live minimum.
riskDisclosure.solverPaymentPriority: principal + accumulatedYield, paid before the liquidator incentive (EswapMarginHookLogic2.sol:496-500)
riskDisclosure.keeperStatus: EswapLiquidationKeeper is unit-tested but NOT deployed on Unichain; no automated liquidation is currently active on the live deployment.
riskDisclosure.positionOwnership: The fill credits the position DIRECTLY to the order recipient. The order's receiver must resolve back to the order owner, otherwise ReceiverMismatch.

constraints: appData MUST equal leverageCommitment(leverage) EXACTLY, or the fill reverts LeverageCommitmentMismatch (EswapCoWSettlement.sol:83).
Only fee tier 3000 ETH/USDC is registered; registerPool is owner-only.
The settlement contract is not yet deployed on Unichain — do not publish live orders.
Do not describe solver capital as guaranteed; it is a senior priority claim with badDebt as the shortfall path.
Do not imply an active automated keeper until EswapLiquidationKeeper is deployed.
